entries.question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
entries.evidence: incredibly poweful foils refers to cardKingdomFoilId is not null AND cardKingdomId is not null
entries.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE NOT cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL AND NOT cardKingdomId IS NULL

entries.question: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
entries.evidence: unknown power refers to power = '*' or POWER IS NULL; commander play format refers to format = 'commander'; legal for commander play format refers to format = 'commander' where status = 'Legal'
entries.gold_sql: SELECT T1.id, T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Legal' AND T2.format = 'commander' AND (T1.power IS NULL OR T1.power = '*')

entries.question: Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
entries.evidence: with the most ruling information refers to Max(count(rulings.uuid)); the card is the promotional printing refers to isPromo = 1;
entries.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name, T1.artist, T1.isPromo FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS count_uuid FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist) AS subquery)) LIMIT 1

evidence.why: the statement bounds its result with LIMIT and states no ORDER BY, so which rows it returns is whatever the plan produced first

entries.question: What is the mana cost of cards with a normal layout, a 2003 frame version, with a black border color, and available in paper and mtgo?
entries.evidence: available in paper and mtgo refers to availability = 'mtgo,paper'; frameVersion = 2003;borderColor = 'black'
entries.gold_sql: SELECT manaCost FROM cards WHERE availability = 'mtgo,paper' AND borderColor = 'black' AND frameVersion = '2003' AND layout = 'normal'

entries.question: Which card costs more converted mana, "Serra Angel" or "Shrine Keeper"?
entries.evidence: "Serra Angel" refers to name = 'Serra Angel'; "Shrine Keeper" refers to name = 'Shrine Keeper'; card costs more converted mana when the value of convertedManaCost is greater
entries.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper') ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

evidence.keys_sql: SELECT convertedmanacost AS k0 FROM cards WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper') ORDER BY convertedmanacost DESC NULLS LAST

entries.question: Please list the Italian names of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
entries.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; Italian refers to language = 'Italian'; highest converted mana cost refers to MAX(convertedManaCost)
entries.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' ORDER BY T2.convertedManaCost DESC NULLS LAST

entries.question: Please list top three elements of the toxicology of the molecule TR000 in alphabetical order.
entries.evidence: TR000 is the molecule id;
entries.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY T.element NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

evidence.contradiction: maximum intent with an ascending first key

evidence.keys_sql: SELECT t.element AS k0 FROM atom AS t WHERE t.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY t.element NULLS FIRST

entries.question: Please list top three molecules that have single bonds between two atoms and are not carcinogenic in alphabetical order.
entries.evidence: label = '-' means molecules are not carcinogenic; single type bond refers to bond_type = '-'; list top three molecules refers to return molecule_id and order by molecule_id;
entries.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T2.label = '-' ORDER BY T2.molecule_id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

evidence.contradiction: maximum intent with an ascending first key

evidence.keys_sql: SELECT t2.molecule_id AS k0 FROM bond AS t1 INNER JOIN molecule AS t2 ON t1.molecule_id = t2.molecule_id WHERE t1.bond_type = '-' AND t2.label = '-' ORDER BY t2.molecule_id NULLS FIRST

entries.question: What is the eligible free rate of the 10th and 11th schools with the highest enrolment for students in grades 1 through 12?
entries.evidence: K-12 refers to students in grades 1 through 12; Eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)`
entries.gold_sql: SELECT CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) FROM frpm ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

entries.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
entries.evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code
entries.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1.NumTstTakr, 0) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

evidence.keys_sql: SELECT CAST(t1.numge1500 AS real) / (NULLIF(t1.numtsttakr, 0)) AS k0 FROM satscores AS t1 INNER JOIN schools AS t2 ON t1.cds = t2.cdscode ORDER BY CAST(t1.numge1500 AS real) / (NULLIF(t1.numtsttakr, 0)) ASC NULLS FIRST

entries.question: What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?
entries.evidence: the highest longitude refers to the school with the maximum absolute longitude value.
entries.gold_sql: SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(longitude) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

evidence.keys_sql: SELECT abs(longitude) AS k0 FROM schools ORDER BY abs(longitude) DESC NULLS LAST

entries.question: List out the account numbers of female clients who are oldest and has lowest average salary, calculate the gap between this lowest average salary with the highest average salary?
entries.evidence: Female means gender = 'F'; A11 refers to average salary; Gap = highest average salary - lowest average salary; If the person A's birthdate > B's birthdate, it means that person B is order than person A.
entries.gold_sql: SELECT T1.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T2.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T2.A11 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

evidence.keys_sql: SELECT t2.a11 AS k0 FROM account AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS t3 ON t1.account_id = t3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS t4 ON t3.client_id = t4.client_id WHERE t2.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'F' ORDER BY birth_date ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) ORDER BY t2.a11 DESC NULLS LAST

entries.question: For the branch which located in the south Bohemia with biggest number of inhabitants, what is the percentage of the male clients?
entries.evidence: Percentage of the male clients = DIVIDE(COUNT(male clients), COUNT(clients)) * 100; Male refers to gender = 'M', A3 is the region name. A4 contains the information about inhabitants.
entries.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.client_id), 0) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.A3 = 'south Bohemia' GROUP BY T2.A4 ORDER BY T2.A4 DESC LIMIT 1

keys.cast_sql: SELECT (CAST(sum(CASE WHEN t1.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS real) * 100) / (NULLIF(count(t1.client_id), 0)) FROM client AS t1 INNER JOIN district AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id WHERE t2.a3 = 'south Bohemia' GROUP BY t2.a4 ORDER BY CAST(t2.a4 AS numeric) DESC LIMIT 1

entries.question: Which are the top ten withdrawals (non-credit card) by district names for the month of January 1996?
entries.evidence: Non-credit card withdraws refers to type = 'VYDAJ'; January 1996 can be found by date LIKE '1996-01%' in the database; A2 means district names
entries.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.A2 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.type = 'VYDAJ' AND CAST(T3.date AS TEXT) LIKE '1996-01%' ORDER BY T1.A2 ASC LIMIT 10

evidence.contradiction: maximum intent with an ascending first key

evidence.keys_sql: SELECT t1.a2 AS k0 FROM district AS t1 INNER JOIN account AS t2 ON t1.district_id = t2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS t3 ON t2.account_id = t3.account_id WHERE t3.type = 'VYDAJ' AND CAST(t3.date AS text) LIKE '1996-01%' ORDER BY t1.a2 ASC
